d: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, bringing an extraordinary chapter of Portuguese football history towards its end. After representing Portugal for more than two decades, the 41-year-old superstar will step away from the national team after the November international break, leaving behind an astonishing 234 appearances and 146 goals, both all-time men's international records. From his international debut in 2003 and the heartbreak of Euro 2004 to captaining Portugal to their historic Euro 2016 triumph and winning the UEFA Nations League in 2019 and…
